result.summary:
I researched how SEO-strong Polish locksmith, emergency-opening and car-key websites are built, across Warsaw, Kraków, Wrocław and Łódź, and then mapped the Kielce search results. Main limits: the search tool is US-based rather than google.pl, and direct page fetching was blocked. So the ranking order is approximate (unverified), and page details come from search snippets, not full page reads. Where I report a competitor's wording it is paraphrased; nothing is copied.

Main patterns:
(1) Exact-match domains with city + 24h, such as pogotowie-zamkowe-{city}-24h.pl, win for "pogotowie zamkowe [miasto] 24(h)". Several cities share one phone number, which suggests lead-gen networks (an inference, not verified).
(2) Site structure: home page, one page per service, a price list (cennik), district and nearby-town pages, a few blog guides, and FAQ blocks.
(3) Titles stuff in city + 24h/24/7 + phone number + "from X zł" price + arrival time, sometimes with emoji, ©/® or "Nr 1".
(4) Trust signals: 24/7, 15–30 min arrival, quote by phone before the technician leaves, pay after the job, ID check, police licence or registry entry, OC insurance, VAT invoice, warranty, Google review counts.
(5) District and town coverage often turns into thin template pages, some down to individual streets. Google classes this as doorway abuse, which is the clearest weakness we can beat.

Kielce opportunity: the Kielce results are weak. They are mostly directories, marketplaces and Facebook pages (Fixly, OLX, pkt.pl, naprawek, blisco, dobrymechanik), plus a handful of thin business sites. Almost nobody combines car opening, home opening, deep car-key content (lost keys, keyless, documents) and DPF/ECU on one credible local site with a real address and a verifiable 5.0 Google rating.

findings.topic: 1. Who ranks for 'pogotowie zamkowe warszawa 24(h)' (the user's reference query)
findings.detail: Results are dominated by exact-match domains (EMDs) and keyword domains, not brands. Seen for the Warsaw queries: pogotowie-zamkowe-warszawa-24h.pl (phone in title 784-799-733, prices from 250 zł), pogotowie-zamkowe-warszawa-24.pl (a separate site, 722 173 570), pogotowie-zamkowe-warszawa.pl (title says services from 97 zł and arrival in 15-30 min), pogotowiezamkowewarszawa24h.pl, pogotowiezamkowewaw.pl, pogotowie-zamkowe.com.pl, pogotowiezamkowe.com.pl, pogotowiezamkowe.com, awaryjneotwieranie.waw.pl (788 05 06 07), otworzymy-zamek.pl (505 424 720), otwieramyzamki.pl (LOCKSTAR), serafin24h.pl, slusarz-warszawa-24h.pl, slusarz-warszawa.pl, slusarz-zamki.pl and abc-zabezpieczen.pl. The reference site the user most likely means is pogotowie-zamkowe-warszawa-24h.pl. Its pages include a home page, /slusarz-warszawa/, /awaryjne-otwieranie/, /awaryjne-otwieranie-samochodu-warszawa/ and a cost article /ile-kosztuje-awaryjne-otwieranie-samochodu-i-mieszkania/. It lists Warsaw districts (Mokotów, Wola, Praga Północ/Południe), has a time-of-day price table and claims 224 Google reviews. The exact Google.pl ranking order is unverified because the search tool is not google.pl.

findings.topic: 2. Other big cities: same EMD playbook, apparently run as multi-city networks
findings.detail: Kraków: pogotowie-zamkowe-krakow-24h.pl, awaryjne-otwieranie.krakow.pl, kodowanie-kluczy.pl (ImmoCODE, a car-key specialist), embservice.pl, autopomoc-krakow.pl, abc-zabezpieczen.pl. Wrocław: pogotowie-zamkowe-wroclaw.pl (600 072 722), pogotowie-zamkowe-wroclaw-24h.pl, wroclawskie-pogotowie-zamkowe.pl, starter.wroclaw.pl, mobilekeys.pl, keylesshelp.com, pankluczyk.pl, otwieraniesamochodu.wroclaw.pl. Łódź: pogotowie-zamkowe-lodz-24h.pl, otwieranie24.pl, slusarz32lodz.pl, pan-slusarz.pl, awaryjne-otwieranie-lodz.pl, pogotowie-zamkowe24.com. The number 600-277-499 appears on pogotowie-zamkowe-lodz-24h.pl, pogotowie-zamkowe-krakow-24h.pl and pogotowie-zamkowe-wroclaw-24h.pl. 784-799-733 appears on both the Warsaw 24h site and a Piaseczno town listing. That points to call-centre or lead-gen networks of near-identical city domains (an inference, unverified). For us: one real, independent local business with real NAP (name, address, phone) can stand out against these networks.
findings.confidence: medium (shared numbers observed; network ownership is an inference)

findings.topic: 3. Kielce search landscape is weak: a real opportunity
findings.detail: For 'awaryjne otwieranie samochodów Kielce', 'ślusarz Kielce 24h' and 'dorabianie kluczyków Kielce', results are mostly directories and marketplaces: fixly.pl (163 contractors, average about 170 zł), OLX ads, pkt.pl, naprawek.pl, blisco.pl (from 199 zł, 30 km radius), kielce-online.pl, 24kielce.pl (a ranking), orlyslusarstwa.pl, cylex, firmy.net, panoramafirm and Facebook pages. Own business sites found: awaryjne-otwieranie-samochodu.com.pl / FLESZ (884 826 075, ul. Mahometańska 6A, says since 2013, all-keys-lost, covers the Świętokrzyskie region); struszynski.pl (states a KWP Kielce licence, key-cutting point at the Puchatek department store; 24h not stated); mecherman.pl (a general 24/7 technical emergency service with a locksmith subpage); slusarz-kielce.pl; pogotowie-zamkowe24.pl (Olmet); immocar.pl (Bilcza: key coding, keyless, ignition locks, emergency opening); D&K and 'Kluczyki Samochodowe Kielce' are Facebook pages only. No Kielce result showed a deep, well-structured car-key + emergency-opening + ECU/DPF site. Exact positions are unverified.

findings.topic: 4. Typical site architecture (page types)
findings.detail: (a) Home page: an all-in-one landing page with a services grid, prices, area served, reviews and FAQ. (b) One page per service, each targeting its own keyword: awaryjne otwieranie samochodów / mieszkań / drzwi / zamków / sejfów, wymiana zamków, naprawy po włamaniu; ImmoCODE adds dorabianie kluczy and naprawa pilotów i kluczy. (c) Price list: /cennik/, /ceny/awaryjne-otwieranie-aut-cennik/, cennik-dorabiania-kluczy.html; some have a separate price page per lock brand (e.g. a Dierre price list). (d) District pages, e.g. /slusarz-targowek/, /slusarz-mokotow/, /pogotowie-slusarskie-krakow-podgorze/. (e) Nearby-town pages, e.g. /pogotowie-zamkowe-krzeszowice/, /naprawa-zamkow-wieliczka/, Piaseczno, Legionowo, Ząbki. (f) A few blog guides, e.g. a cost article, 'what a locksmith's duties are', 'when lock emergency help is useful'. (g) An FAQ block on the home or service pages; Wrocław has a dedicated city FAQ section. (h) Contact / about the company. URLs carry the exact keyword plus city (e.g. /awaryjne-otwieranie-samochodu-warszawa/). Recommended for Kielce, in our own words: Home; separate pages for car opening, flat/house opening, car-key duplication and coding, lost all keys, keyless/remotes, immobilizer/ECU, DPF diagnostics and cleaning; price list; service area plus a few genuinely distinct town pages; FAQ; 4-6 guides; contact/about with NAP.

findings.topic: 5. Title / H1 patterns and keyword placement
findings.detail: Patterns seen in titles (described, not copied): [Pogotowie zamkowe / Ślusarz / Awaryjne otwieranie X] + [City] + '24h' or '24/7' + phone number. Variants: a '©' or '®' prefix; 'from N zł' plus arrival time in the title; emoji (🔑, 🔐, 🥇); a CTA verb in the title ('Zadzwoń teraz' / 'Zadzwoń!'); superlatives ('Nr 1'); district format 'Ślusarz [District] — [City] 24h'. Keywords sit in the domain, the title, the URL slug and repeated in H1/H2. One site (serafin24h.pl) uses an extremely long comma-separated keyword list as its title, which is pure stuffing. For us: one main keyword phrase + Kielce + 24h, with the phone number at the end, under about 60 characters. Example structure (our own): 'Awaryjne otwieranie samochodów Kielce 24h | tel. 668 292 270'. H1 should be the natural phrase, e.g. 'Awaryjne otwieranie samochodów i mieszkań w Kielcach – 24h'. Keep separate pages for 'dorabianie kluczy samochodowych Kielce' and 'kodowanie / programowanie kluczyków Kielce'.

findings.topic: 6. Page sections (typical order on home / service pages)
findings.detail: Recurring blocks: (1) Hero: service + city + 24/7 + arrival time (15-30 min is the most common claim) + a big phone button. (2) Service tiles: cars, flats/doors, safes, lock replacement, post-burglary repairs, key-cutting. (3) 'How it works' steps: call → describe problem and address → price agreed by phone before departure → arrival → non-destructive opening → payment after the job. (4) Price ranges or a price table. (5) Area served: a list of districts and nearby towns. (6) Why us: experience, years in business, licence, insurance, invoice, warranty. (7) Reviews / Google review count. (8) FAQ. (9) Contact, often with company address and schema data. Car-key specialists add: supported brands and key types (transponder, remote, keyless/smart key, Renault card), all-keys-lost explanation, remote repair, ignition lock repair, and mobile-service details (cut and program on site). Our version should also add a 'what to prepare' box (ID, registration certificate (dowód rejestracyjny), VIN) and a clear 'we do NOT remove DPF' note.
findings.confidence: medium-high (from snippets, not full page reads)

findings.topic: 7. Price presentation patterns
findings.detail:
Competitors show 'from' prices and ranges and explain what drives the price.

Emergency opening:
- Price factors cited: car make and year, double locking (podwójne ryglowanie), parking location, time of day.
- Time-of-day table on pogotowie-zamkowe-warszawa-24h.pl: weekday 7-20 = 250 zł, rising to 400 zł late at night or at weekends.
- Net prices plus 23% VAT for 6:00-23:00 (awaryjneotwieranie.waw.pl): car without double locking 100-150 zł net, with double locking 150-200 zł net, newest models from 200 zł.
- 'Travel within the city included' (pogotowie-zamkowe.com.pl).
- Night/weekend surcharge (+50 zł on one list); trunk with steel body from 350 zł; premium cars from 300 zł.
- Door opening: 150-300 zł typical, anti-burglary doors more.
- Kielce: Fixly average about 170 zł; blisco from 199 zł; an OLX Kielce car-key ad 250-800 zł.

Car keys:
- ImmoCODE price list by transponder type: T2/T5 about 180, Texas about 250.
- Coding from 150 zł (Wrocław); chip key from 250 zł (Toruń).
- Key with remote from 450 zł; smart key/keyless 650-1450 zł (Warsaw mobile mechanic).
- kb.pl Warsaw averages: fixed-code key 453 zł, variable-code key 722 zł.

Weak spot: the same site often gives different prices on its FAQ and its price list, and does not say whether prices are net or gross. All figures are as advertised and unverified.

findings.topic: 8. FAQ questions competitors answer (themes to cover in our own words)
findings.detail:
1. Will opening damage the lock or door? Answer: non-invasive first; drilling only as a last resort, mainly for damaged or post-burglary locks.
2. How long is arrival, and how long does the job take? Arrival 15-30 min; a standard flat door 15-30 min; anti-burglary or multi-point 30-60 min; electronic or master-key systems up to about 90 min; a car from a few to a dozen-plus minutes.
3. What documents do I need? For a flat: ID with address, rental agreement, deed, or a person present to confirm. For a car: registration certificate (dowód rejestracyjny) + ID.
4. Do you work nights, weekends and holidays?
5. How much does it cost, and is the price agreed before work?
6. Do you issue a VAT invoice?
7. What should I do while waiting? (e.g. wait in the stairwell or at a neighbour's)

Car-key FAQs:
8. I lost all my keys – can you make one without the original? Needs ID + registration certificate + 17-character VIN; honest workshops always ask for documents.
9. How long does coding take, and does it work for keyless?
10. Is the remote included / can a broken remote be repaired?
11. Should I move the car if I lost keys together with documents?

Also: is emergency opening covered by my assistance insurance? (CUK says partly, e.g. PZU, Proama, Link4 – exact coverage unverified.)

Add DPF/ECU questions that competitors in this niche do not answer: cleaning vs. removal, diagnostics first, ECU reset after cleaning.

findings.topic: 9. Trust signals used (and how verifiable they are)
findings.detail:
Claims seen:
- 24/7 operation (sometimes in schema openingHours Mo-Su 00:00-23:59).
- Arrival-time promises: 15-30 min, 'from 15 min', 'a few minutes'.
- Price agreed by phone before departure; payment after the job.
- Proof of right to the flat or car checked before opening.
- Police licence or registry-entry numbers: one Warsaw firm states licence 0011527 and 'since 2000'; a Tricity firm states PZT-22889; struszynski.pl mentions a KWP Kielce licence; an OLX Kielce ad mentions police-confirmed entry on the technical-security workers list.
- OC (liability) insurance.
- VAT invoice, sometimes receipt; warranty (e.g. manufacturer warranty + 12 months on fitting, 6 months on repairs).
- Years on the market; Google review counts (224 on the Warsaw 24h site; '5.0 from 750+' on a Łódź site); payment by BLIK; customer quotes on the page.

Most of these are self-declared with no link to proof. Whether a police licence is still legally required is unverified; the sites assert it without an official source.

For us, verifiable signals beat claims: link to the real Google Business Profile (5.0 rating) and embed real reviews; show the real address (ul. Chodkiewicza 45A, Kielce) and company data (NIP – to be supplied by the client); add real photos of the van/equipment and of jobs; state the ID/ownership-check policy; invoices; no DPF removal. Do not invent licence numbers, years or review counts.

findings.topic: 10. CTA patterns
findings.detail:
Observed:
- Phone number repeated in the title, header and hero, and next to every service.
- CTA verbs in titles ('Zadzwoń teraz', 'Zadzwoń!').
- 'Free quote by phone'.
- Quote by SMS with a photo of the lock and the street name (Kielce OLX locksmith).
- A 24/7 order form when the phone line has limited hours (naprawek.pl Kielce listing: phone 7-22, form 24/7).
- Payment methods shown (BLIK).

A sticky mobile call bar and floating call buttons are common on this kind of site, but I could not confirm them because pages could not be fetched (unverified).

Recommendation for our site: a sticky bottom bar on mobile with [Zadzwoń 24h] (tel:+48668292270) + [SMS/WhatsApp with photo] + [Dojazd/Mapa]; a click-to-call button in the hero and after every section; 'price confirmed before we leave' microcopy; for car keys, a short form (make, model, year, key type, all keys lost yes/no, location).

findings.topic: 11. How competitors handle districts, neighbourhoods and nearby towns
findings.detail:
Four approaches seen:
- (a) A page per city district. Warsaw: Targówek, Wesoła, Żoliborz, Wawer, Mokotów, Bemowo, Białołęka, Wilanów, Śródmieście. Kraków: Podgórze, Nowa Huta, Dębniki, Krowodrza, Czyżyny, Łagiewniki, Mistrzejowice.
- (b) Pages for satellite towns: Krzeszowice, Wieliczka (presented as if it were a Kraków district), Piaseczno, Legionowo, Ząbki; Oława and Oleśnica named on a Wrocław page.
- (c) Extreme versions:
  - street-level pages (slusarz-zamki.pl: 'Piaseczno ul. Szkolna', 'ul. Pawia Piaseczno', 'Piaseczno ul. Wyspiańskiego');
  - service × district pages (mobilnymechanikwarszawa.eu: lost-key immobilizer key + Mokotów + 24/7; lost keys + Wola);
  - separate microsites per town (pogotowie-zamkowe-piaseczno.pl);
  - brand × town directory pages (serwisujmojeauto.pl 'Busko Zdrój' + brand).
- (d) A simple area list inside the content. Mecherman Kielce lists estates (Centrum, Ślichowice, Podkarczówka, Barwinek, KSM, Świętokrzyskie, Na Stoku) and municipalities (Masłów, Sitkówka-Nowiny, Miedziana Góra, Strawczyn, Zagnańsk, Morawica, Chęciny, Piekoszów).

For Kielce: one strong 'Obszar działania' page with a map, the estates and the surrounding municipalities. Add distinct pages only where we can write unique, true content (realistic travel time from Chodkiewicza 45A, typical jobs there, main road access such as S7/DK73/DK74 – to be confirmed by the client).

Candidate towns:
- near: Masłów, Morawica, Chęciny, Piekoszów, Sitkówka-Nowiny, Zagnańsk, Miedziana Góra, Daleszyce, Strawczyn, Górno;
- further: Skarżysko-Kamienna, Starachowice, Jędrzejów, Busko-Zdrój, Końskie, Pińczów, Ostrowiec Świętokrzyski.

Those further towns' results are again mostly directories and tow-truck sites (e.g. laweta-pomoc-drogowa-holowanie.pl, pomocdrogowa.info), so they are winnable. Confirm the actual travel radius with the client.

findings.topic: 12. Weaknesses we can beat: thin or doorway pages and duplicates
findings.confidence: high (Google policy); duplicate-template judgement medium (from snippets)

findings.topic: 13. Weaknesses we can beat: inconsistent, unverifiable or sloppy content
findings.detail:
Inconsistencies and sloppiness:
- pogotowie-zamkowe-krakow-24h.pl says 06:00-24:00 on its main page while district pages say 24h.
- awaryjneotwieranie.waw.pl gives different car prices in its FAQ and its price list; both are net, with VAT added separately.
- Wieliczka is presented as a Kraków district.
- Copy on some home pages is disordered, with sentences that look pasted in at random.
- Some pages are very old (directories show listings 3000+ days old).
- Many sites show no NIP or real address.

Unverifiable claims:
- 'Ślusarz Nr 1', 'arrival in a few minutes', 'without damage' presented as a guarantee;
- review counts with no link to the Google profile;
- licence claims with no number.

Keyword stuffing: very long keyword-list titles; repetitive keyword copy noted on suburban pages.

Our edge: consistent facts across all pages (one price logic, one set of hours, one phone number), net/gross stated explicitly, realistic arrival times worded as typical rather than guaranteed, honest limits (when drilling or lock replacement is needed), a visible date or 'last updated' on the price list, and real photos.

findings.topic: 14. Car-key niche: content depth is the gap
15. DPF and ECU results in Kielce: separate competitors, compliance as a differentiator
findings.detail:
DPF in Kielce:
- Competitors are specialists and aggregators: dobrymechanik.pl (183-617 zł listed), filtry-dpf-fap.pl (a Kielce page with 188 workshops), dpfecoserwis.pl (440 zł gross regeneration, diagnostics from 190 zł), dpf-expert.pl, klinikadpf.pl (24h turnaround, 12-month warranty claimed), dmfservice.pl, regeneracja-dpf-kielce.supermechanik.pl, autoserwisraczkowski.pl.
- Aggregators also run a 'wycinanie filtrów DPF Kielce' (DPF removal) page with 91 services, while specialists warn that removal risks fines.
- Our angle: 'diagnostics, regeneration and cleaning – we do not remove DPF'. That is a trust and compliance message the locksmith-type competitors cannot offer. Describe the process in our own words: pressure measurement before and after, flushing, checking the ceramic insert, ECU adaptation/reset after refitting.

ECU:
- sterowniki-ecu.pl has a Kielce city page for ECU repair; OLX ads mix legal services with 'IMMO OFF / DPF OFF'.
- These services should get their own pages, linked from the car-key pages, so they do not dilute the emergency-opening page.

All advertised prices here are unverified.

findings.topic: 16. Keyword map for Kielce (derived from competitor targeting)
findings.detail:
Primary keywords, grouped by page:
- Home / emergency: 'pogotowie zamkowe Kielce', 'ślusarz Kielce 24h', 'awaryjne otwieranie Kielce', 'otwieranie drzwi Kielce', 'awaryjne otwieranie mieszkań Kielce'.
- Car opening: 'awaryjne otwieranie samochodów Kielce', 'otwieranie samochodów Kielce 24h', 'zatrzaśnięte kluczyki w aucie Kielce'.
- Keys: 'dorabianie kluczy samochodowych Kielce', 'dorabianie kluczyków Kielce', 'kodowanie kluczyków Kielce', 'programowanie kluczyków Kielce'.
- Lost keys: 'zgubione kluczyki Kielce', 'dorobienie kluczyka bez oryginału'.
- Keyless/remotes: 'kluczyk keyless Kielce', 'naprawa pilota samochodowego Kielce'.
- Immobilizer/ECU: 'immobilizer Kielce', 'naprawa sterownika silnika Kielce'.
- DPF: 'czyszczenie DPF Kielce', 'regeneracja DPF Kielce', 'diagnostyka DPF Kielce'.

Modifiers competitors stack: 24h, całodobowo, z dojazdem, cena, cennik, [town name].

Price aggregators (kb.pl, cenauslug.pl, zleca.pl, fixly) target '[usługa] [miasto] cena/cennik', so the price page should explicitly target 'awaryjne otwieranie samochodu Kielce cena' and 'dorobienie kluczyka Kielce cena'.

Search volumes are unverified (no keyword tool available).

findings.topic: 17. Technical and local SEO extras seen, and recommendations
findings.detail:
Observed:
- LocalBusiness structured data with 24/7 openingHours (pogotowie-zamkowe.com.pl).
- Google review counts placed in the header.
- GBP-generated mini-sites (localo.site) with a /reviews page pulling Google reviews.
- Shared NAP across networks.

Recommendations:
- Schema: LocalBusiness with Locksmith + AutoRepair types; areaServed listing Kielce and the surrounding municipalities; openingHours 24/7; the same NAP as the Google Business Profile.
- Do not mark up self-written reviews as aggregateRating. From existing knowledge, Google does not show review stars for self-serving LocalBusiness reviews; this was not re-verified in this session. Link to the GBP instead.
- The client's GBP primary category is 'Mechanik samochodowy'. Competitors' pages target 'ślusarz' and 'pogotowie zamkowe', so the client should consider adding locksmith/key-related secondary categories. Exact Polish category names and the best choice are unverified.
- Google Ads advanced verification for locksmiths is listed for US/Canada; Poland is not named in the policy pages found (unverified for Poland).
- Pages must load fast on mobile: emergency searches are mostly mobile, which is a general best practice, not measured here.

result.summary:
Local keyword and competitor research for a Kielce mobile emergency-opening and car-key business (GBP address ul. Chodkiewicza 45A, which search results place in the Baranówek area). The search tool returned no search-volume data, so the keyword priorities below are my judgement from intent, how competitive the results looked, and how well each phrase fits the business. Every volume figure is unverified.

Main conclusions:
(1) The highest-value terms are the "awaryjne otwieranie samochodów/aut Kielce" cluster and the "dorabianie / kodowanie kluczyków samochodowych Kielce" cluster. They are contested by a few car-focused firms: FLESZ Kielce, Key-Med/immocar.pl, awaryjneotwieranie.com.pl and awaryjne-otwieranie-samochodu.com.pl. General locksmiths and directories mostly fill the "pogotowie zamkowe / ślusarz 24h Kielce" results.
(2) Many local competitors say "24h" but their own pages give limited phone hours (for example 6/7–22). Their directory listings also show different addresses, phone numbers and hours. A site and GBP that are truly 24/7 with consistent contact details is a real differentiator.
(3) No Kielce competitor surfaced that combines car opening, all-keys-lost, immobilizer/ECU and DPF (cleaning, not removal) with home opening. That full-service mix is the business's distinct position.
(4) Searches for the nearby gminas (Chęciny, Morawica, Masłów, Piekoszów, Daleszyce, Nowiny, Zagnańsk) returned no locksmith or car-key provider. That is the clearest ranking gap: unique town pages can capture it. Skarżysko-Kamienna, Busko-Zdrój and Jędrzejów already have local providers, so they are secondary.
(5) DPF and ECU searches are crowded with dedicated DPF sites and aggregators, and several competitors also advertise DPF/IMMO/AdBlue "off". A clearly legal "we clean and regenerate, we do not remove" message, plus long-tail diagnostic queries, is the realistic way in.
(6) The Warsaw "pogotowie zamkowe 24" sites follow a repeatable pattern: 24/7 headline, stated arrival time, service-area or district list, price-range table, FAQ, and "price agreed before work". The new site should rebuild that structure with Kielce-specific content written from scratch.

Licence claims (police or MSWiA licence numbers), competitors' ratings and prices come only from competitor or aggregator pages and are unverified.

findings.topic: Keyword priority 1: emergency car opening cluster (home page + dedicated service page)
findings.detail: Target keywords (Polish): 'awaryjne otwieranie samochodów Kielce', 'awaryjne otwieranie samochodu Kielce', 'otwieranie samochodów Kielce', 'otwieranie aut Kielce', 'otwieranie samochodu Kielce 24h', 'zatrzaśnięte kluczyki w aucie Kielce'. Intent: urgent, transactional, mostly on mobile; the searcher wants to call now. Page: the home page H1/title should lead with car opening plus 24h plus Kielce (this matches the GBP name), backed by a dedicated page /awaryjne-otwieranie-samochodow-kielce. Evidence: several competitors build exact-match domains or pages for this phrase (awaryjne-otwieranie-samochodu.com.pl, awaryjneotwieraniekielce.pl/samochodu, awaryjneotwieranie.com.pl/samochody, kielecki-slusarz.pl/awaryjne-otwieranie-samochodow), which signals commercial value. Search volume: unverified (no keyword tool available).
